audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Mordekaiser while whys[1] calls it a coinflip; Level 6 and first item read Dr. Mundo while whys[4] calls Level 6 your single biggest spike and whys[5] calls first item strong but conditional.
audit.why: Three rows contradicted their own why cells, and Level 6 is the row a Mordekaiser player actually plans around. The packet levelChart (Mordekaiser / Skill / Skill / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Dr. Mundo) matches every why.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, and phases[5] and [6] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heart Zapper was the tracked cooldown on ten surfaces with no duration, and no ability in his kit carried a number.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1 and the heal lands on the burst at the end — the anti-heal has to be applied before that recast, which is a timing instruction the page could not give without the number.
audit.corrected: Heart Zapper written as 17s at rank 1 with the burst-heal timing, Infected Bonesaw as a 4s 975-range cleaver, Maximum Dosage as 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Goes Where He Pleases was never mentioned. His passive resists the first immobilising effect that hits him — which means Death’s Grasp, the pull the whole trade pattern is built on, can be eaten outright. Infected Bonesaw was also described as %max-HP damage in three places; Riot’s text says current health.
audit.why: A pull that gets negated changes every engage decision in the lane, and current-health scaling behaves the opposite way to max-health scaling when you are low.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.you[0] state the passive block and tell you to strip it first; dontsFull[1].d, phases[6].why and whys[6] correct the cleaver to current health.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's plus Grievous makes the all-in lethal, but only while the anti-heal is up — strong, conditional, and a timing race.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Dr. Mundo's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage plus stacked HP out-heals your flat aura, and his cleaver scales on your current health, so bulk does not save you. Hunt him in side skirmishes.

edits.before: - Dr. Mundo Heart Zapper: matchup-defining — His sustain spike + reset. R him when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Dr. Mundo Infected Bonesaw: Throws a cleaver that slows and deals %current-HP magic damage; refunds HP. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Dr. Mundo Heart Zapper: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1; it banks the damage you deal and heals him on the burst, so land Grievous before the recast. - Dr. Mundo Infected Bonesaw: a 4s, 975-range cleaver scaling on your current health.

edits.before: His sustain spike + reset. R him when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 17s at rank 1 and heals him on the burst — land Grievous before he recasts.

edits.before: That is Dr. Mundo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His passive eats the first immobilise on him, so Death's Grasp can be wasted.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The cleaver is 4s on a 975-range throw and scales on your current health.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage is 120s and instantly heals a percent of his missing health, then regenerates more over a long duration — chasing him into it is free HP.

edits.before: Track Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper: His sustain spike + reset. R him when it’s down. When it is down — R him — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Heart Zapper: 17s, and it banks your damage and heals him on the burst. His passive eats the first immobilise — Death's Grasp can whiff.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage plus stacked HP out-heals your flat aura DPS while his % max-HP cleaver shreds your bulk — the unkillable drain-tank simply reclaims the late game.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage plus stacked HP out-heals your flat aura DPS while his current-health cleaver chips you from 975 — the drain-tank reclaims the late game.

edits.before: Bank Darkness Rise stacks and use E to pull Mundo off his minions so the aura ticks on him in extended trades he can't kite out of
edits.after: Spend an early E to strip his passive immobilise-block, then pull him off his minions so the aura ticks in a trade he cannot leave

notes: Left alone, recorded as unverified: spikes[0].text, early and whys[0] say Infected Bonesaw costs Mundo his own HP to cast. The kit file lists cost 0 and Riot’s description says nothing about a health cost, so I neither repeated nor removed the claim. Also not asserted: Mordekaiser Q’s derived grounding flag, and the derived percentHealth flag on Maximum Dosage (the R heals a percent of his MISSING health, it does not deal percent-health damage). Possible mirror disagreement: the drmundo-side audit records its chart as Mordekaiser from Level 1 through first item, which would overwrite the three Skill rows here; this side’s packet and all seven whys read Skill on Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and first item.
